$description: Dark Minimal preset — sleek dark-mode palette with a green accent and low-chroma slate neutrals. Suitable for developer tools, code editors, terminal UIs, and monitoring dashboards. It sets all 69 colour slots and all 27 chart slots from one brand recipe (dark roles and charts) over brand A's light and dark themes; every other slot starts from brand A. Load it as a starting point with brand.intake (action "template", from { "preset": "dark-minimal" }), then validate and create the brand. Brand-relative: no color.brand.<id> wrapper, so it serves any brand.
